title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the case of Elene Khoshtaria and political prisoners under the Georgian Dream Regime
part_text: 6. Reaffirms its unwavering support for the Georgian people and their elected representatives in their pursuit of a sovereign, prosperous and democratic European future without external interference; calls on the EU to avoid a black-and-white contrast between the different actors and not to continue its current policy, which only increases the polarisation of Georgian society and politics;
